          SPECIFICATION
          
Technical Notes

          
Splits the token on '.' delimiters and Base64Url-decodes the Header (Part 1) and Payload Claims (Part 2), formatting `iat` and `exp` Unix timestamps into ISO dates.

          
Frequently Asked Questions

          
Does decoding prove that a token is authentic or still valid?
No. This tool only displays decoded JSON. It does not verify the signature, issuer, audience, or access rights. Do not trust a token solely because its payload can be decoded.
